permaworld.slotmark.tooltip.favorite:
Favorite (Slot Reservation)

• Enable this and click inventory slots to reserve them for that item type.
• Useful to prevent other items from occupying that space.
permaworld.slotmark.tooltip.lock:
Lock slot (Prevent sorting/emptying)

• Enable this and click slots to lock them.
• Locked items won't move when sorting or depositing into chests.
• Or hold ALT and click a slot to toggle quick lock.
permaworld.config.title: Eria Permaworld
permaworld.config.debug.tooltip: Enables detailed debug logs in the Minecraft console.
permaworld.config.packet_delay.tooltip: Adds a delay in milliseconds to client-sent inventory packets. Prevents desyncs.
permaworld.config.sort.enabled.tooltip: Enables the quick-sort button and keybind for inventory and containers.
permaworld.config.sort.show_name.tooltip: Displays the alphabetical 'A' sort button in containers and inventory.
permaworld.config.sort.show_count.toolti: Displays the count-based '#' sort button in containers and inventory.
permaworld.config.sort.show_category.too: Displays the category-based 'T' sort button in containers and inventory.
When enabled, you can click and drag any sorting or quick-drop button directly in chest/inventory screens to reposition them. Disables button actions while editing.
permaworld.config.sort.button_size.toolt: Size in pixels of the inventory quick-sort button.
permaworld.config.sort.button_offset_x.t: Horizontal offset of the sort button relative to the top right of the inventory.
permaworld.config.sort.inventory_offset_: Vertical offset of the sort button in the inventory or crafting table.
permaworld.config.sort.container_offset_: Vertical offset of the sort button in chests and other containers.
permaworld.config.quick_drop.enabled.too: Enables quick drop. Allows auto-depositing matching items into recently opened chests.
permaworld.config.quick_drop.show_button: Displays a quick deposit button inside the chest interface.
permaworld.config.quick_drop.radius.tool: Search radius in blocks for recently opened chests to deposit items.
permaworld.config.slot_lock.enabled.tool: Enables locking and marking inventory slots to protect your items.
permaworld.config.slot_lock.protect_pick: Rejects picking up items from the ground if they don't match your favorited slots.
permaworld.config.slot_lock.drag_brush.t: Allows marking multiple inventory slots by dragging the mouse when active.
permaworld.config.trader.enabled.tooltip: Enables the favorite trade manager and interface on villagers.
permaworld.config.trader.marked_buy_butt: Displays quick bulk buy buttons for Local (L) and Global (G) favorites.
permaworld.config.trader.buy_button_size: Size in pixels of the quick buy buttons.
Separation gap between the quick buy buttons.
permaworld.config.trader.buy_button_offs: Horizontal position offset for the quick buy buttons.
Vertical position offset for the quick buy buttons.
permaworld.config.trader.reset_buy_butto: Resets the villager screen bulk buy buttons to their default layouts.
permaworld.config.harvest.enabled.toolti: Enables right-clicking crops with a sickle (hoe) to harvest and replant in area.
Allows applying bone meal in an area when using sickles.
permaworld.config.harvest.bonemeal_from_: Automatically searches and uses bone meal from your hotbar when holding a sickle.
permaworld.config.harvest.stone_area.too: Harvest area width in blocks for the stone sickle.
permaworld.config.harvest.iron_area.tool: Harvest area width in blocks for the iron sickle.
permaworld.config.harvest.diamond_area.t: Harvest area width in blocks for the diamond sickle.
permaworld.config.harvest.netherite_area: Harvest area width in blocks for the netherite sickle.
permaworld.config.reset_layout.tooltip: Resets the inventory quick-sort button size and positions to their defaults.
Enables profiles and drag-and-drop support to reorder resource packs easily.
permaworld.config.resource_pack.delete_b: Displays a trash button in the resource pack list to delete local folders directly.
